name: Structural Connectome MRTrix3 (SCMRT)
summary: Builds structural connectivity matrices (count, density, length and mean diffusion or quantitative MRI measures) from a tractogram and volumetric parcellation with MRtrix3 tck2connectome, optionally using streamline labels and weights.
description: Optionally filters the tractogram by a binary streamline labels file and applies precomputed streamline weights, then builds symmetric count, density, length and density-of-length matrices and mean-measure matrices for any tensor, NODDI, quantitative MRI, myelin or spherical-mean maps supplied. Endpoint-to-node assignment can be tuned with radial, reverse and forward search options. Also outputs the streamline assignments as a labels datatype.

inputs.description: Volumetric parcellation with label.json; each label becomes a network node.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: Optional DTI/DKI maps (FA, MD, RD, AD and kurtosis maps if present); used to build mean-microstructure matrices.
Optional NODDI maps (NDI, ODI, ISOVF); used to build mean-microstructure matrices.
Optional binary per-streamline labels; only streamlines labelled 1 are kept before building matrices.
Optional per-streamline weights (e.g. SIFT2) applied in tck2connectome; subset to match when labels are also given.
Optional quantitative MRI maps (T1, R1, M0, PD, MTV, VIP, SIR, WF); used to build mean-measure matrices.
Optional myelin map; used to build a mean-measure matrix.
Optional spherical-mean map; used to build a mean-microstructure matrix.

outputs.description: All connectivity matrices as CSV files (count, density, length, density-of-length and per-measure mean matrices).
Connectivity matrix datatype (csv/correlation.csv with label.json) of streamline counts between node pairs.
Connectivity matrix datatype (csv/correlation.csv with label.json) of mean streamline length between node pairs.
Connectivity matrix datatype (csv/correlation.csv with label.json) of streamline counts scaled by inverse node volume.
Connectivity matrix datatype (csv/correlation.csv with label.json) of length-scaled counts normalised by inverse node volume.
Streamline-to-node-pair assignments from tck2connectome as a labels datatype.

parameters.description: perform a radial search from each streamline endpoint to locate the nearest node. Argument is the maximum radius in mm; if no node is found within this radius, the streamline endpoint is not assigned to any node. Default search distance is 4mm.

traverse from each streamline endpoint inwards along the streamline, in search of the last node traversed by the streamline. Argument is the maximum traversal length in mm (set to 0 to allow search to continue to the streamline midpoint).
project the streamline forwards from the endpoint in search of a parcellation node voxel. Argument is the maximum traversal length in mm.
if you want to scale the length and den len matrices by either inverse length (true) or the length (false)
